correctness.rationale: The continuous switch state is explicit. A third-order expansion of the exact rotation product gives the \(O(h)\) middle-pulse correction from the second-order endpoint equation and the excess-time coefficient \(r(1-r)/3\) from the next independent tangent equation. Nonzero leading derivatives for \(0<\Delta<1\) give a local implicit-function branch. A standalone exact-rotation replay reproduces the coefficient and exact grid alignment.
